from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    n, t = map(int, input().split())

    tate = defaultdict(set)
    yoko = defaultdict(set)
    naname = defaultdict(set)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            tmp = n * i + j
            tate[j].add(tmp)
            yoko[i].add(tmp)
            if i == j:
                naname[0].add(tmp)
            if i + j == n - 1:
                naname[1].add(tmp)

    A = list(map(int, input().split()))

    cnt = 0
    for a in A:
        a -= 1

        i = a // n
        j = a % n
        tate[j].discard(a)
        yoko[i].discard(a)
        if i == j:
            naname[0].discard(a)
        if i + j == n - 1:
            naname[1].discard(a)
        cnt += 1
        if (
            len(tate[j]) == 0
            or len(yoko[i]) == 0
            or len(naname[0]) == 0
            or len(naname[1]) == 0
        ):
            print(cnt)
            return

    print(-1)
